add.title: How I write to this screen
add.text:
**Tool:** `page_add` / `page_set` on path `/live/`. I pass only the card fields; the tool stamps `id`, `by: voice-app`, `ts` and appends one line to `public/live/page.jsonl`.

**The line it wrote for this card:**
```json
{"content":{"add":{"id":"how-live-writes","type":"part-card","title":"How I write to this screen","text":"…"}},"by":"voice-app","ts":"…"}
```

**page.js** holds no data, three lines: `new Live({ meta, title: "Live", classes: "hides-nav" })`.

**Live.js** replays the jsonl: `clear` empties the Map, `add` sets by id, `remove` deletes, a line keyed by an existing id merges `title`/`text` in place. `draw()` renders each Map item as a row.

**Edit in place** (what I'll use for progress updates, one line each):
```json
{"how-live-writes":{"text":"new text"},"by":"voice-app","ts":"…"}
```

**Not yet:** feed order newest-first, preview/full view per card, subpages. Those are the next experiment.

Design the UX first, then build.

What exists: framework/ui (widgets), ext/Mention (icon + name + link), Page.preview_card, templates (core/Page/Template). None of it is reachable from a feed line yet. A card line today:

```json
{"id": "ui-design", "type": "part-card", "preview": "UI design", "title": "UI design", "text": "..."}
```

Proposed: a card whose header is a real thing, via mention, and which can carry a theme:

```json
{"id": "page-ctx", "type": "part-context", "of": "#Page", "classes": "dark", "content": ["page-tools", "ui-design"]}
```

`of` resolves through ext/Mention to icon, name, url. `content` lists child card ids, so the context card groups them.

```js
class ContextCard extends LiveCard {
	header(){ return mention(this.of); }   // icon + name, links through
}
```

add.title: Where we are: the card system
add.text:
**Built, working now**
- Feed on /live: add, remove, edit by id; preview and full view; title first, edit later.
- Text is one markdown blob. `#Page` and `@owner` render as icon + link via ext/Mention.
- One custom renderer (Today) registered in code, by `live` name.

**Not built**
- A card body as a list of items with ids, so an edit touches one paragraph, not the blob.
- A registry: every UI piece (framework/ui widgets, ext/*, Page subclasses) addressable by a `type` from a jsonl line.
- Context cards (header = a real thing, children grouped).
- Server-side page instances (requirements doc only).
- Tool collapse (plan only; direction: Item.set is the universal call).

**Plan, in order**
1. Registry: `type` on a line picks a class. Start with three: text, code, mention.
2. Body as `content` list of typed items, each with an id. Edits are then `{"<card>": {"<item>": {"text": "..."}}}`.
3. Context card = a card whose header is a mention and whose content is other cards.

Surgical word-level edits stay a rewrite of one small item; that is fine once items are small.

add.title: What is a LiveCard? The four classes behind /live
add.text:
All in [/live/Live.js](/framework/files/?path=live/Live.js), 150 lines.

**Live** extends #Page. The page itself. Owns the log and draws the feed, newest first.

**LiveLog** extends JSONL. Replays page.jsonl: `clear` empties, `add` inserts by id, `remove` deletes, a bare id merges fields. This is the delta engine for this page.

**Tail**. Polls page.jsonl every ~3 s with a byte Range; only new bytes are replayed. The thing a socket would replace.

**LiveCard** extends #Page. One feed row as a small page. `preview()` draws the stock preview card you see in the feed; `full()` draws back-link, title, markdown body. A custom renderer (only Today so far) is picked by a `live` name.

So: a card is a Page, which is why I keep saying the registry should be Page subclasses picked by `type`.

Also found: `framework/library/` (Library, Collection, Entry, Item, Rail, Stage) is new and unexplored; it may overlap.

add.title: Task audits we've run (partial — still counting)
add.text:
**The honest state: there is no master list of audits anywhere. They're scattered across session folders. This card is the first time they're gathered in one place.** A full count was still running when this was posted; this is what's confirmed from `public/framework/ai/sessions/`.

There are **40+ folders with "audit" in the name** and dozens of audit files. The substantial, recent ones:

| When | Audit | Lives at | What it covered |
|---|---|---|---|
| Oct 15 | refine audit | sessions/2026/10/15/voice-20261015/ai-system/audit.md + refine-audit/ | Prompt-refine rules, bugs, redesign proposal (built partly, then stalled) |
| Oct 13 | landing check | sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/landing-check/audit-table.md | What repo-slim tasks actually landed |
| Oct 12 | readme audit | sessions/2026/10/12/session-87bec773/readme-audit/audit-before/after.json | Readme coverage before vs after |
| Oct 8 | task audit | sessions/2026/10/08/.../task-audit/doc/directory-audits.md | Directory-level task audit |
| Oct 8 | prompt audit | sessions/2026/10/08/prompt-audit/prompt-audit/audit.json | Prompts review |
| Oct 3 | day audit | sessions/2026/10/03/day-audit/audit-2026-10-03.json | One day's work |
| Sep 29 | page-system inventory audit | sessions/2026/09/29/.../page-system/inventory-audit.md | Page system inventory |
| Sep 29 | prompt-refine audit | sessions/2026/09/29/.../prompt-refine/audit.md | Earlier refine pass |
| Sep 05 | paging + spacing audits | sessions/2026/09/05/ (20+ folders: paging-audit-1..8, spacing-audit-a..d) | Layout/paging — biggest cluster |
| Aug–Sep | css, launch, site, taste, layout, ui-behaviors audits | sessions/2026/08/ + 09/ | Early design/layout audits |

**The pattern, plainly:** audits got *done* but were never *collected*. No index, no "was it useful" verdict, no follow-up list. That's the actual bug — not that the work didn't happen. Next: the past-work mastermind will turn this into a live, queryable list with a useful/waste verdict per audit.

task-audits.title: Task audits
task-audits.text:
**The honest state: there is no master list of audits; they were done but never collected.** This card gathers the recent ones and now gives each a verdict (useful, stale or waste) and whether it was followed up. Verdicts are the past-work mastermind's read from the audit files and git history (2026-10-16); the 40+ older folders (css, launch, site, taste, layout, ui-behaviors) are not judged yet.

| When | Audit | Verdict | Followed up? | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Oct 15 | refine audit (`sessions/2026/10/15/voice-20261015/ai-system/`) | **useful** | **yes** | Redesign proposal led to the Cleaner class page and the refine-build task (spawned Oct 16). |
| Oct 15 | framework/ai readme audit (`ai-system/audit.md`) | **useful** | **yes** | Found 3 real dead links by script; its smoke-test rule is now in the mastermind skill. Also showed Haiku link-checking was wrong 11 of 14 times. |
| Oct 13 | landing check (`session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/landing-check/`) | **useful** | **no** | 8 real findings (branches with missing code); no commit mentions fixing them. |
| Oct 12 | readme audit (`session-87bec773/readme-audit/`) | **useful** | **yes** | Led to the readme-length rule and the Oct 15 re-audit. |
| Oct 8 | task audit (`.../task-audit/doc/directory-audits.md`) | **stale** | **no** | Its one proposal (`ux/Dictate/doc/pieces.md`) says "Not written"; the directory data has since changed. |
| Oct 8 | prompt audit (`sessions/2026/10/08/prompt-audit/`) | **useful** | **partly** | 259 asks, 215 landed; it listed 10 unbuilt asks, but its own agent died (revived 0 times) and the list was never worked through. |
| Oct 3 | day audit (`sessions/2026/10/03/day-audit/`) | **stale** | **no** | One day's landed/left-over list; the left-over items are now covered by newer ledgers. Its script re-runs for any day. |
| Sep 29 | page-system inventory audit | **useful** | **yes** | Found 2 confirmed broken pages; the page system was reworked after. |
| Sep 29 | prompt-refine audit | **useful** | **yes** | Tab vs tool comparison of 3 dictations; it is the basis of the Refine rebuild. |
| Sep 05 | paging + spacing audits (21 folders, paging-audit-1..8, spacing-audit-a..d) | **waste (as a pile)** | **yes** | Eight rounds reached "6/6 at 5" (see the paging program), but the 21 folders are rounds of one loop; keep the final round, the rest is noise. |
| Aug-Sep | css, launch, site, taste, layout, ui-behaviors audits | **not judged** | **unknown** | Early design audits; too old to verify cheaply. |

**The pattern, plainly:** audits got done but were never collected, and the ones nobody followed up (landing check, task audit) are the ones with no owner. The open fix is an `audits.jsonl` written by `finish-task` so this list builds itself. How the verdicts were made: file heads, `git log`, and the audit's own landing lines, not a full read of each.
